parts.final:
For an empty file, `parseGrid` returns `[]`. The guard at `pkg/grid/parse.py:6-7` (`if not text.strip(): return []`) catches empty and whitespace-only input before any parsing happens.

This is from reading the code, not from running it. I did not check how callers load the file, so this assumes the file's contents are passed in as `text`.
